Both changes are saved and the API accepted each write (200 OK). I re-read the stored values to confirm them.

- **Main colour:** The portal has assisted colour mode on, which only lets you set the primary, secondary and accent colours. I set the primary to dark green `#1B5E20` in `theme.assistedModeColors`. The regular `theme.colors.primary` still reads `#1976D2`, because assisted mode recalculates it from the assisted value when the draft is saved. If you want a different green, tell me the hex code. If you would rather set the background or text colours by hand, you would need to turn assisted mode off first, and I have not done that.
- **Menu:** I added "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (the free page with slug `jeunesse`) as the third item, after "Accueil" and "Catalogue de données". Its label is the page title, so no custom label was set.

I changed nothing else. To update the theme I had to resend the whole theme block, and I copied the font CSS by hand. The API cannot check that text, so if the portal's fonts look wrong, that copy is the first place to look.
